purpose: Compare two actual successful bounce Trim8 clips: old split process and new single-service v2. Full native decode bytes and timelines only, not quality PASS.
audio_hash_rule: Preserve native decoded dtype and values; transpose planar channels x samples to sample x channel, normalize byte order to little endian without resampling, hash C-order bytes continuously across frames. Record native format/layout/dtype and independent exact rational PTS metadata.
video_hash_rule: Hash every RGB24 uint8 HWC frame in decode order; keep only one frame payload at a time. Record separate exact PTS/time-base metadata.
source_binding: Freeze worker, plan, inputs, InferRSI executor/process source. Before decoding bind actual generation result, media summary and decode report SHA; full MP4 SHA before and after, unchanged dev/ino/size/mtime.
limitations: Decoded byte identity under this decoder is not quality equivalence or perceptual quality PASS.
Container hash differences do not alone prove metadata-only changes.
Wall time below is CPU evidence collection cost, not inference performance.
